notes.title: Halloween Sale and Upcoming 1.1.2 Patch Update
notes.content:
[b]Post-Halloween Sale[/b]

Halloween might be in the rearview mirror now but from November 1 to 8, HAPPY SAIN† SHEOL will be on sale with a 10% discount! If you're still on the fence about picking up this title, now's your chance to get it with a nice discount as well.

[i]Actually, Valve didn't think the game was spooky enough to be in the Steam Scream Fest promotion but it is what it is. [/i] ːsteammockingː

As always, the demo is also available on Steam for folks who want to try the game out before making a purchase.

[b]1.1.2 Patch Update[/b]

There will be a major update coming up very soon. Here's a brief list of updates coming:

[list]
[*]Updated, new scenario text
[*]Steam achievements support
[*]Various bug fixes as reported by users since release
[/list]

Regarding the updated scenario files, the developer felt that certain scenes weren't properly fleshed out enough and additional scenario text will be added to some of those scenes. Since this new content that wasn't there before, it will take a bit of time for our localization team to go over and get to work on. Nevertheless, we're hopeful this update will be available to users in the coming weeks.

As always, thank you for your support and please continue to enjoy HAPPY SAIN† SHEOL!

notes.title: 1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
We hope everyone has been enjoying the release of HAPPY SAIN† SHEOL.

An update has been pushed out with a number of fixes.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Scenario text related fixes
[*]Renamed save folder (in ...\AppData\Roaming\RenPy)

The second point is important because of an issue stemming from users who previously purchased the game on Booth. Both builds used the same save data folder which caused unintended issues when having save data from the Booth version and then playing the Steam version.

To avoid any further issues, the save data folder in AppData was renamed to something unique to avoid further issues. For affected users, it may be necessary to delete the existing save data and persistent file before starting a new game. In most standard installations, the specific folder can be found here:

C:\Users\[USERNAME]\AppData\Roaming\RenPy

Everyone else should be able to proceed through the game without issue. We apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused.

[b]Upcoming Updates[/b]

Steam Achievements are scheduled to be implemented in a future update. In addition, the staff roll will be updated to include everyone involved with the localization of HAPPY SAIN† SHEOL. Steam cards are also in the planning stages to be added to the game.

notes.title: Demo Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that the HAPPY SAIN† SHEOL demo now available on Steam! While the game itself didn't make it in time for a 2023 release, users can still get a taste of what's to come in this demo. There are still some bugs that need to be fixed so check back for more updates in the near future.

Do give us your thoughts on the demo and if you enjoyed it, don't forget to hit that wishlist button to be informed of when the full game will be out!
